 Julianne Hough shows off pre-‘DWTS 35’ semifinals glam with co-host Alfonso Ribeiro
 Julianne Hough is ready to bring her signature style to the 'Dancing with the Stars' season 35 semifinals on Tuesday night. 
 By 
 Josh Sanchez 
 | 
 November 17, 2026 
 Mar 10, 2024; Los Angeles, CA, USA; Julianne Hough on the red carpet at the 96th Oscars at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles on Sunday, March 10, 2024. Mandatory Credit: Robert Hanashiro-USA TODAY Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) 
 Season 35 of the hit reality series Dancing with the Stars is winding down, with the semifinals coming our way on Tuesday night. As is always the case leading up to showtime, host Julianne Hough took to social media to show off her look for the night. 
 While gearing up for Tuesday night, Hough showed off a pre-show photo with co-host Alfonso Ribeiro. 
 Hough was wearing a black minidress with a sheer back and knee-high boots, while Ribeiro was looking relaxed in his quarter-zip. We’ll have to see how the two ramp up their outfits for showtime, but fans were eating up the duo ahead of the 8:00 p.m. ET kickoff. 
 MORE: ‘Dancing with the Stars’ 35 spoilers: Semifinals song list & dance styles 
 Julianne Hough Goes All Black Ahead of ‘DWTS 35’ Semifinals
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Julianne Hough (@juleshough) 
 “The best duo! Your bond is incredible,” one fan wrote. Another added, “The best hosting duo… I’m not ready for this season to end.”
 The chemistry between Hough and Ribeiro on stage every week is part of what makes Dancing with the Stars feel like such a special event, and they share that energy with the contestants each season. 
 MORE: Julianne Hough brings vintage Hollywood beauty to ‘Dancing with the Stars’ Dedication Night 
 During Tuesday night’s semifinals, the duo is going to have to bring their A-game to keep contestants energized as they each perform two routines while competing for the fans’ votes. Each pair will perform a ballroom and Latin dance routine throughout the night, so get your popcorn ready. 
 New episodes of Dancing With The Stars will air weekly every Tuesday night live on ABC and Disney+ beginning at 8:00 p.m. ET, with next-day streaming available on Hulu.
